deadline.value: Admission is requested through GRADUS at the start of the thesis work; no fixed deadline is stated.
deadline.quote: You have to submit your application for admission via GRADUS at the beginning of the work on your PhD thesis.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: A signed agreement on doctoral studies with the supervisor is part of the application.
supervisor.quote: Signed agreement on doctoral studies with: Work plan and timetable and information on your individual qualification program

funding.value: Most doctoral candidates at Stuttgart already hold a paid doctoral job; this is a university-wide statement.
funding.quote: Most individual doctoral degree candidates at the University of Stuttgart already have a paid doctoral student job and work as research assistants for the University.

entry_route.value: A master's degree, or a degree of at least four study years, is the entry rule.
entry_route.quote: a) master’s degree studies at a university in the Federal Republic of Germany or | b) degree studies with a standard period of study of at least four study years
